page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.24xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.g8i family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and runs under the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz.

The server is configured with 384.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage options. There are no integrated GPUs on this instance type.

For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps. This high-throughput network interface, combined with the large dedicated core count, makes the instance suitable for enterprise applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and general-purpose workloads that require substantial parallel processing without specialized GPU acceleration.
